logline: 바다 밑 인어가 물에 빠진 젊은이를 구하고, 뭍으로 오르려 목소리를 내준다.
destination: 뭍의 궁 — 두 다리로 서게 된 자리
protagonist: 긴 은빛 머리에 비늘 꼬리를 가진 어린 인어
anchor: a young mermaid with long silver hair and a pale scaled tail
palette: deep blue-green, pale white, warm amber, cold grey, pearl silver

mermaid.label: 인어
mermaid.desc: a young mermaid with long silver hair, pale skin, a scaled blue-green tail, shell ornaments

prince.label: 젊은이
prince.desc: a young man in his twenties, dark wavy hair, embroidered coat, high boots

witch.label: 바다 마녀
witch.desc: a pale gaunt woman with white drifting hair and long thin arms, dark robes trailing

seabed.label: 바다 밑
seabed.desc: an undersea garden of coral and swaying weed, shafts of blue light from above

storm_sea.label: 폭풍 바다
storm_sea.desc: black waves under torn clouds, spray blowing off the crests

shore.label: 바닷가
shore.desc: a pale empty beach at dawn, low cliffs behind, foam along the sand

palace.label: 궁
palace.desc: a candlelit stone hall with tall windows and polished floor

beats.beat: 인어가 바닷속 정원에서 물 위를 올려다본다.
beats.visual: a young mermaid among coral in an undersea garden looking up toward the bright surface
a wooden sailing ship heeling over on black storm waves under torn clouds
beats.motion: the hull leans steadily further over

beats.visual: a mermaid holding a limp young man above the waves, both small against the swell
beats.motion: she holds him steadily above the water

beats.visual: a mermaid slipping back into shallow water from a pale beach, a young man lying on the sand
beats.motion: she draws steadily back into the shallows

beats.visual: a young man in soaked clothes rising on one elbow on a pale beach at dawn
beats.motion: he lifts steadily onto one elbow

beats.beat: 인어가 바다 밑 깊은 굴로 헤엄쳐 간다.
beats.visual: a mermaid swimming toward a dark cave mouth on the sea floor, weed streaming past
beats.motion: she swims steadily toward the cave

beats.beat: 굴 안의 마녀가 잔 하나를 내민다.
beats.visual: a pale sea witch holding out a small cup to a mermaid in a glowing cave
beats.motion: the cup moves steadily toward the mermaid

beats.beat: 인어가 모래밭에 두 다리로 누워 있다.
beats.visual: a young woman lying on wet sand with bare human legs, sea foam around her
a young man leading a barefoot young woman up a stone path toward a palace
beats.motion: they move steadily up the path

beats.visual: a barefoot young woman turning in a candlelit palace hall, courtiers watching
beats.motion: she turns steadily across the floor

beats.visual: a young woman looking down at her own bare feet on cold palace stone
beats.motion: her head lowers steadily toward her feet

beats.visual: a young man taking another woman's hand before a palace altar, guests behind

beats.beat: 여자가 새벽 뱃전에 홀로 서 있다.
beats.visual: a young woman alone at a ship's rail at first light, wide grey sea beyond
beats.motion: her hair streams steadily in the wind

beats.visual: an empty ship's rail at sunrise, spray on the wood, wide open sea
beats.motion: spray runs steadily down the rail

withheld: 인어가 목소리를 대신 내준 것과, 마지막에 인어가 맞는 새벽
